privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how BizUply collects, stores, uses, and protects personal and business information across the platform.
privacyPage.overviewText: Quickly navigate between the sections on privacy, data, security, user rights, and legal terms.

s1.p1: This policy describes how Bizuply LLC collects personal information on the BizUply platform. Bizuply LLC is a company registered in the United States. The state of formation, registration number, and official address are not in the verified website sources, so they are not stated here. Privacy requests: privacy@bizuply.com.
s1.p2: BizUply is business-management software. This policy covers bizuply.com, user accounts, and information submitted in forms, registration, and payment.
s1.p3: This Privacy Policy applies to all of our products, services, websites, and applications (the “Platform”) and describes in detail how we process data, what information we collect, and what rights you have with respect to your information.
s1.p4: By accessing or using our Platform, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use BizUply or any of its services.

s2.p1: This Privacy Policy applies to all users, including businesses, employees, administrators, affiliates, and website visitors who interact with BizUply in any manner, whether through desktop, mobile applications, API integrations, or third-party add-ons.
s2.p2: Governing law, venue, and the state of formation are unresolved. This draft does not state that New York or Delaware law applies.
s2.p3: This policy does not apply to third-party services, links, or integrations that are not owned or operated by BizUply. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before engaging with them.

s3.p1: The public site names Bizuply LLC as a US company. The state of formation, registration number, and street address are not verified in the code.
s3.p2: “The Platform” – includes all BizUply products, websites, systems, servers, applications, APIs, AI modules, CRM dashboards, automation tools, and related software infrastructure.
s3.p3: “User” – any natural or legal person who uses BizUply's services, including business owners, employees, customers, or website visitors.
s3.p4: “Personal Information” – data that identifies or can reasonably identify an individual, including but not limited to name, email, phone number, address, payment details, business profile data, and digital identifiers such as IP addresses or cookies.
s3.p5: It is not verified that every provider has signed a confidentiality or processing agreement.

s4.p1: BizUply collects both personal and non-personal data necessary to provide, improve, and secure its services. Data collection may occur directly from you, automatically through your device, or from verified business integrations.
list1: Full name, email, and phone number
Business name, registration number, and address
Communications, reviews, and feedback submitted through the Platform
list2: IP address and approximate geographic location
Device type, browser version, and operating system
Session activity, interaction history, and timestamps
Cookies and tracking pixels for analytics and performance
list3: AI analysis of performance metrics and recommendations
Aggregated insights generated from anonymized usage data

s5.p1: BizUply uses the information collected solely for legitimate business purposes related to operating and improving its Platform. We do not sell or rent personal data under any circumstances.
list: To provide and maintain our services and customer accounts
To process payments, invoices, and billing cycles
To improve product performance, UX, and AI accuracy — excluding user data received through Google Workspace APIs, as set out in Section 7
To send service updates, notifications, or marketing offers
To ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements
To prevent fraud, misuse, or unauthorized access
To support customer service and resolve technical issues
To analyze user behavior for statistical and security purposes
s5.p2: It is not verified that processing meets any particular state's privacy standard.

s6.p1: It is not verified that every provider has signed a confidentiality or processing agreement.
s6.p2: The providers below appear in the code. This repository does not state each provider's storage region, and the region cannot be inferred from the provider's name.
list: Lemon Squeezy — payment and the platform subscriptions shown on the pricing page
MongoDB — the application database. The region is not stated in this code
Railway — application server hosting. The region is not stated in this code
Vercel — public website hosting
Cloudinary — uploaded image files
Resend — email delivery
OpenAI — AI features when a user invokes them
Meta — WhatsApp Business API, ad connections a business chooses, and the measurement pixel only after the visitor allows it
Google Fonts — font files
Stripe — store checkout and billing paths where the code still calls Stripe
Twilio — the internal phone system, when that connection is enabled
Cloudflare Turnstile — bot checks on signup screens where the site key is configured
s6.p3: It is not verified that every provider has signed a confidentiality or processing agreement.
s6.p4: We may disclose information to law enforcement, government agencies, or legal advisors if required to comply with applicable laws, court orders, or to protect our rights, security, or property, including fraud prevention and dispute resolution.
s6.p5: In the event of a merger, acquisition, reorganization, or asset sale, personal data may be transferred to the acquiring entity, provided that the same data protection obligations continue to apply.

s8.p1: Essential cookies are stored so the site can run. Marketing measurement loads only after an explicit choice.
list: Essential: language (bizuply_lang), sign-in, and the saved choice (bizuply_tracking)
Marketing: Meta pixel 1427327632368128 and the _fbp cookie, only after measurement is allowed
s8.p2: Choosing essential only stops the pixel from loading. The choice can be reset with the button on this page.
s8.p3: Google Analytics was not loaded on the public site that was checked. Do Not Track is not implemented.

s9.p1: A form enquiry is kept as a support ticket until an operator deletes it. The product has no self-service account deletion or automatic export. Access, correction, and deletion requests go to privacy@bizuply.com. A fixed retention period needs an owner decision.
s9.p2: The public site is served over HTTPS. This policy does not claim encryption at rest, a firewall, or two-factor authentication. Two-factor authentication is not currently offered to users.
s9.p3: In the event of a data breach, BizUply will notify affected users as required by law.

Accessing or using BizUply's services constitutes your full and binding consent to comply with all provisions of this Agreement. If you do not agree to these terms, you must not use the Site, the App, or any of the Company's services.
s1.p3: 1.3. The Company reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to change, amend, update, or remove parts of these terms at any time, with or without prior notice. Any update takes effect immediately upon posting on the Site. Continued use of the platform after such a change constitutes full acceptance of the updated terms.
s1.p4: 1.4. These terms are written in English and may from time to time be translated for convenience into other languages. In the event of any conflict or inconsistency between translations, the English version shall prevail.

s2.intro: For the purposes of this Agreement, the following definitions shall apply:
s2.defs:
“The Company” – BizUply LLC, the operator and owner of the platform, including its affiliates, employees, partners, and contractors.
“The Site” / “The App” – BizUply's digital system, including all websites, domains, databases, APIs, code, infrastructure, interfaces, and related digital assets owned or managed by BizUply.
“The User” – any person, professional, business, organization, or other legal entity that accesses or uses the services for business management, communication, or collaboration purposes.
“Service Provider” / “Business” – any registered business or independent professional using the platform to create a business profile, manage appointments, customers, tasks, or communication through BizUply.
“Customer” – any person or entity that interacts with a business or service provider through the BizUply platform.
“The Services” – all features and functions provided by BizUply, including but not limited to CRM tools, messaging, appointment scheduling, automation, AI-driven insights, analytics, reputation management, collaboration tools, reviews, ratings, and business-page creation.
“Content” – any data, media, or material submitted, uploaded, transmitted, or displayed on the platform, including text, images, videos, logos, reviews, reports, analytics, or other user-generated material.
“Agreement” – this Terms of Use document, which constitutes a legally binding agreement between the User and BizUply.

s3.p1: 3.1. BizUply provides an advanced Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform for the comprehensive management of small and medium-sized businesses (“SMBs”). The services are designed to help business owners organize, track, and automate their day-to-day operations through a unified, cloud-based system. Available features include, among others:
list: Customer relationship management (CRM) for customers and leads
Internal messaging and communication between businesses and customers
Calendar, booking, and appointment-scheduling tools
A verified reviews system and star ratings for customer feedback
Customizable business pages with descriptions, service lists, images, and FAQs
Features for task management, reminders, and follow-ups
Collaboration tools between businesses for shared growth opportunities
An AI-powered business advisor for recommendations and smart automation
Analytics dashboards and performance reports for optimization
